newsitem.title: USA: Control Data agrees to holding co deal.
newsitem.headline: Control Data agrees to holding co deal.

text.p: Control Data Systems Inc and CDSI Holding Corp reached a definitive agreement for CDSI to acquire all outstanding common shares of Control Data at $20.25 per share, Control Data said Wednesday.

The agreement was unanimously approved by the boards of director of Control Data and CDSI, a holding company formed at the direction of investment firm Welsh Carson Anderson & Stowe, Control Data said.
CDSI, through a subsidiary, will promptly begin a tender offer to purchase all outstanding shares of Control Data, it said.
The cash tender offer will be followed by a cash merger to acquire all shares not tendered, also at $20.25 per share.

The tender offer is expected to commence on July 15 and is subject to receipt of at least 51 percent of the fully diluted shares of common stock of Control Data Systems, as well as the satisfaction of various other conditions, Control Data said.
"The board and management of Control Data Systems fully endorse this proposed acquisition," Control Data Chief Executive Jim Ousley said in a statement.
Control Data Systems was formed in August 1992 through a stock dividend to the shareholders of the original Control Data Corporation, which is now Ceridian Corp.
Control Data is a global software and services company.
